title: Console: route experiment creation wizard (variants + traffic split editor + confirmation)
author: Felix Schneider
release_notes: Console (flagged): Adds a multi-step wizard to create route experiments, including variant setup, an allocation/traffic split editor with validation, and a final confirmation step that previews the generated config before create.
body:
## Summary
Implements the first end-to-end Console workflow for creating a route-level experiment:
- Multi-step creation wizard (Basics → Variants → Traffic split → Confirmation)
- Traffic split editor with validation + “normalize” helper
- Confirmation step that renders a read-only preview of the experiment config payload and required permissions

This PR is UI-only (no backend schema changes). It targets the API added in PR-28511 and stays behind the `route_experiments` feature flag.

Design notes: incorporates feedback from DES-311 review (labeling, guardrail copy, and split editor UX). See Design Review section below.

## Motivation / context
Route-level experiments are one of the missing pieces in Rollouts. We need a guided workflow that:
1) prevents invalid config (bad splits, empty variants),
2) makes the blast radius clear (route + environments), and
3) keeps the “create” action safe and auditable.

## UX / flow
### Step 1: Basics
- Fields: Experiment name, Description (optional), Route selector, Owner team (optional)
- Route selector uses existing Rollouts route picker and normalizes route ID display (template path) to reduce confusion

### Step 2: Variants
- Add/remove variants (A/B/n) with:
  - Variant name (display)
  - Variant key (stable identifier; autogenerated, editable with validation)
  - Target model (from model catalog drop-down)
- Inline warnings:
  - Duplicate variant keys
  - Missing model selection
- Max variants: 5 (UI-only guard; aligns with current product intent while backend enforcement lands separately)

### Step 3: Traffic split editor
- Allocation table for variants:
  - Percentage inputs per variant
  - Total must equal 100%
  - “Normalize to 100%” action if user enters arbitrary numbers
  - Quick presets: 50/50 (2 variants), 90/10 (2 variants), equal split (n variants)
- Validation:
  - Reject negative values
  - Disallow all-zero
  - Rounding strategy: UI stores allocation as integer percent; sum enforced to 100. (We intentionally do not support fractional % in this iteration.)
- Accessibility: arrow-key stepper support for numeric inputs, visible error summary at top of step

### Step 4: Confirmation
- Read-only “configuration preview” section showing the payload that will be sent to Console API:
  - route_id
  - variants[{key, model_id, allocation_percent}]
  - metadata: name, description
- “You’re about to create an experiment (in Draft)” copy; create does not automatically start the experiment
- Permissions panel:
  - Shows required permissions (RBAC capability strings) and current user status
  - If missing permission, disable Create and show action hint (request access)

## Feature flag / rollout
- Entire wizard is behind `route_experiments`.
- Entry point: Experiments → “Create experiment” button appears only when flag is enabled.

## Design review feedback addressed (DES-311)
- Updated step labels: “Traffic split” instead of “Allocation” (per Kenji)
- Added “normalize” helper action and preset buttons to reduce mental math (per Tessa)
- Tightened copy on Confirmation step to explicitly state Draft semantics and that no traffic moves until Start (per Marissa feedback relayed in DES-311)
- Added inline help text clarifying that split is deterministic by stickiness key, not random per request (links to docs stub)

## Implementation details
- New components:
  - `RouteExperimentWizard` (step orchestration + data model)
  - `TrafficSplitEditor` (allocation table, validation, presets)
  - `ExperimentConfigPreview` (confirmation read-only rendering)
- Form state managed with `react-hook-form` + zod schema per step; step progression is blocked when the current step is invalid.
- Validation is duplicated intentionally:
  - client-side zod schema for UX
  - server-side validation remains the source of truth (error messages are mapped into field-level errors on API failure)

## Error handling
- API errors:
  - 400 validation errors are mapped back to fields when possible
  - 403 shows a dedicated RBAC callout with required permission strings
  - network/timeouts: toast + retry

## Screenshots / recordings
- Included in internal PR attachments:
  - Wizard stepper + variant table
  - Traffic split editor with errors + normalize
  - Confirmation payload preview

## Testing
- Unit:
  - Traffic split validation (sum=100, rounding, normalize)
  - Variant key uniqueness + required fields
- Integration (React Testing Library):
  - happy path through all steps
  - API 400 mapping to field errors
  - RBAC 403 disables Create

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Guardrail configuration step (thresholds) will be added in a separate PR once backend guardrail model is finalized.
- Sticky key selection UI (header/customer/session) pending final product decision.

## Checklist
- [x] Feature flagged
- [x] Keyboard nav + a11y pass (basic)
- [x] Handles API 400/403 correctly
- [x] Added tests for split editor
- [x] Copy reviewed with Design

Refs: ENG-9025, DES-311, PM-482
commits: console/experiments: implement Variants step + model picker integration
console/experiments: add TrafficSplitEditor with presets + normalize
console/experiments: implement Confirmation step with config preview
console/experiments: map API validation errors to wizard fields
console/experiments: add RBAC permission callouts and disable create on 403
test(console): add unit + integration coverage for traffic split editor
changed_areas: console-web/src/api/experiments.ts (create route experiment client + error mapping)
review_conversation: Tessa Morgan (Design): Step 3 label should be “Traffic split” not “Allocation”. Also can we add a normalize action and common presets so users don’t have to do math?
Felix Schneider (Author): Updated copy to “Traffic split”, added presets (50/50, 90/10, equal split) and a normalize button that rescales entered values to 100. Pushed in 6f2a0a9.

Kenji Nakamura (Design): The percent inputs feel cramped. Can we keep the error state visible without jumping the table? Also add helper text about deterministic assignment so people don’t assume per-request randomness.
Felix Schneider (Author): Adjusted column widths, moved error summary above the table, and added helper copy + docs stub link under the editor. Pushed in 1b8c7d4.

Dylan Brooks: Please ensure create does NOT implicitly start the experiment. Confirmation step should make that explicit. Also, can we cap variants in UI for now to avoid accidental cardinality blowups?
Felix Schneider (Author): Create stays Draft only (no Start call). Added explicit copy on Confirmation step and a UI cap at 5 variants with a clear error message. Pushed in a0c13e1.
Chloe Martin: API returns a structured 400 with field paths. Please map those back to the correct step/field so users don’t get a generic toast. Also handle 403 with RBAC callout.
Felix Schneider (Author): Implemented error mapping (variant keys, allocations, route) and dedicated 403 UI state with required permission strings. Added tests for both. Pushed in 9c21d55.
Kaitlyn Nguyen: Permission strings look correct, but make sure we don’t leak internal role names. Display capability IDs only. Also confirm the UI doesn’t show the debug endpoint link anywhere.
Felix Schneider (Author): Confirmed: capability IDs only; no role names. No debug endpoint references in UI. Updated wording and removed one leftover placeholder. Pushed in c3aa6bd.
Dylan Brooks: Looks good. Please re-run CI; saw a flaky test on the integration suite earlier.
Felix Schneider (Author): Re-ran; green. Marking ready.
Tessa Morgan (Design): Approved from design side.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash merge by Dylan Brooks on 2025-03-06. Squash commit: 2f91c7a (Console: route experiment creation wizard).
